title: Inspect explicitly assumed plaintext CodeBreaker blocks
changes: Add a readonly CLI inspection that requires an explicit plaintext assumption and returns a typed, non-executable plan for a bounded CodeBreaker subset; reject unsupported or incomplete blocks atomically.
Register the CLI operation and update the Atlas inventory without exposing an execution action.
validation: Isolated Windows GNU test and runtime builds passed; Wine synthetic decoder/catalog tests passed 11 with one private-catalog test ignored; final operation registry tests passed 3.
A synthetic Wine CLI proof verified the explicit assumption, conditional and slide plan, atomic refusal and unchanged catalog; operation inventory, Atlas inventory, rustfmt and diff checks passed.
limitations: Device version, encryption, masters and actual ROM behavior are unverified; other opcodes and all guest writes remain unsupported. No real catalog code, ROM, native Windows, Linux runtime or physical controller was tested.
